metaTitle: Custom Mixie Embroidered Patches | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Mixie embroidered patches for uniforms, events & more. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Mixie embroidered patches combine vibrant embroidery with a durable, sew-on or iron-on backing, making them ideal for team uniforms, corporate apparel, and promotional giveaways. Unlike standard patches, Mixie offers a wide range of shapes and sizes, from classic rounds to custom die-cut designs, with high stitch density for a premium look. Whether you need 50 patches for a safety team or 500 for a trade show, Mixie ensures consistent quality and fast turnaround. Decorate with your logo, text, or mascot using up to 15 thread colors for maximum brand impact.
heroAltText: Custom Mixie embroidered patches with colorful thread designs on a fabric background
